content.short: Terminal 3 provides web3’s most powerful user identity and data oracle.
content.description: Terminal 3 seeks to replace centralized data storage that erodes user privacy and places heavy compliance, security, and cost burdens on organizations. By combining decentralized storage with zero-knowledge proofs, it makes user data freely composable across applications while staying private and secure, enabling verifiable anonymity. This approach reduces exposure to data breaches and restrictive data silos, and supports trusted, privacy-preserving data interactions at scale for a range of Web3 services and enterprise workflows.
